name: mcp-telegram-bridge
description: Controlled stdio MCP bridge to the Telegram Bot API with outbound scrubbing and optional chat allowlisting.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.title: Telegram bot token
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Required token created with Telegram BotFather.

ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS.title: Allowed chat IDs
ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram chat IDs. Leave blank to allow all chats visible to the bot.

SAFETY_STRICT.title: Strict safety mode
SAFETY_STRICT.description: Optional flag; use 1, true, yes, or on to enable strict inbound classification.
